messages:
Olivia: Quick kickoff — launching 'Postcard' webinar + benchmark blog next Thu. Goal: 3k signups, 20% activation by day 7. Need creative + routing plan.
Mike: Love it. For creative, we should A/B headline: 'Ship LLM features faster' vs 'Reduce inference costs by 3x'.
Tara: For PLG funnel experiment: propose 3 cohorts -> Free credit (starter 100k tokens), Prompt pack (ready templates), and Guided onboarding (30-min lab). We'll measure DAU, token usage, early NPS.
Sam: Routing question: which inbound source gets credit? webinar signups should get immediate 100k credit and a follow-up prompt pack email + in-app nudges.
Olivia: Agree. Sam can you draft the routing snippets? We'll use /signup?src=postcard and map to trial_credit tag in PostHog.
Sam: Pushing draft: 
```
if (utm_source === 'postcard') {
  user.grantCredit('starter_100k');
  user.track('credit_granted', {experiment: 'postcard_launch'});
}
```
Tara: Nice — include a slack alert for growth when credit granted (growth-bot ping).
Mike: Webinar content: 20min demo + 10min live Q. Benchmarks slide: latency/cost per 1k tokens (hosted vs dedicated), and 'activation checklist' that maps to prompts.
Olivia: CTA threading: 1) sign up 2) claim credit 3) complete 1 prompt from pack -> triggers activation event 'prompt_run'.
Sam: Add follow-up nudges: Day 1 email + in-app checklist; Day 3 idle nudge with 'run 3 prompts' and 50% bonus credit if they complete.
Mike: Copy idea for Day 1 subject: "Welcome — 100k credit inside + starter prompts" short and testable.
Tara: Measurement: funnel events = signup -> credit_granted -> prompt_run -> activation. We'll use cohort IDs and compare across the 3 cohorts. plan to run for 14 days.
Olivia: Assigning owners: Mike (copy + slides), Tara (experiment config + metrics), Sam (routing + infra), Olivia (exec sync + comms). Checkpoints: daily standups next week.
Sam: FYI I've added growth-bot task: /task create 'postcard credit routing' @growth-bot
Mike: :thumbsup: I'll drop first drafts by EOD tomorrow.
